_comment: Library access points: reference material Eve reaches BY NAME and never embeds. Format and tier rules: docs/OPERATING_CONTRACT.md section 7. Paths point at where files already live (the vault is not reorganised); resolve them with read_document, read_active_tool, or the wiki lead path. Keep entries to what actually exists - a wrong path is worse than a missing one.

access_points.title: Vendor product guides (Gumloop, Dify, AnythingLLM, Cursor, FlutterFlow, Ollama, Magic Patterns)
access_points.when: an upstream product detail is needed

access_points.title: Harvested flattened codebases (Tool Forge outputs)
access_points.covers: flattened repos incl. RAINE_ABACUS_PROJ_FOLDER (220 MB), diegosouzapw-OmniRoute (114 MB), sbrookshire-raine_Empire (12.7 MB), plus LEGO_INDEX.md
access_points.when: mining a harvested codebase for patterns or code
access_points.notes: LOAD-BEARING: strict 03_Active_Tools protocol in agent/skills/empire-routing-detail.md; read_active_tool resolves only inside this folder. Never relocate.

access_points.title: Wikipedia corpus, one snapshot year
access_points.covers: 5,347,264 article files; Eve reads ~1800-char lead plus one 1400-char section
access_points.when: a factual lookup that should carry a citation

access_points.title: Application manuals and how-to guides held in the memory bank
access_points.covers: ~449 guide-like markdown files, e.g. 'Assembly Line Operating Guide', 'How to Create AI Movies with LTX-2 on WAN2GP', 'A Beginner's Guide to LLM Fine-Tuning', 'HOW TO READ THIS BOARD'
access_points.when: an app or workflow how-to is needed
access_points.notes: These sit inside the auto-ingested bank, which is why they were embedded. Under the tier rule they are reference, not knowledge - reached by name.

access_points.title: EMPIRE project documentation
access_points.covers: operating contract, audits, playbook, placement, wiki audit, manifest
access_points.when: a question about how EMPIRE itself works

access_points.title: Skills, prompts and reference audio
access_points.covers: 506 markdown prompts/skills plus 88 audio files (~900 MB) and .gdoc/.pce pointers
access_points.when: a prompt pattern or a re-usable skill is needed
access_points.notes: Selected items may be promoted to Foundation deliberately; audio is a transcription job, not a read.
